detail.title: WAKE Architectural Foundations: Governance and Receipt Layering
detail.summary: WAKE✳︎ operates as a layered architecture designed for accountability rather than model persistence. It establishes a hard boundary between the proposal layer (where models generate suggested changes) and the governance layer (where deterministic rules validate transitions against state history). Receipts serve as the immutable ledger, while policy modules ensure consistent, domain-specific normalization of these interactions.
detail.reason: Synthesizing the interaction between the governance rulebook and application policy completes the foundational study of WAKE's architecture.
